fullPassage: Our number one criterion for how we care for our pets should be, “Is this what they actually need? How is it impacting them?” rather than, “What do I want?” For example, we have encountered many dog owners who bathe their dogs religiously multiple times a week because they want to avoid the ‘doggy’ smell, but veterinary dermatologists warn against such practices, as they are not good for a dog’s skin. If someone is really concerned about their dog’s smell they can use waterless shampoo and thoroughly brush their dog every day but keep the baths down to once or twice a week at most. Unless they have a skin condition for which a vet has prescribed medicated baths, most dogs don’t need to be bathed on a regular basis. Regular pet check-ups can help identify health problems before they become severe, making it easier to treat and manage them. Even dogs with thick, heavy coats generally only need baths every 6 to 8 weeks.

questions.passage: Our number one criterion for how we care for our pets should be, “Is this what they actually need? How is it impacting them?” rather than, “What do I want?” For example, we have encountered many dog owners who bathe their dogs <u>religiously</u> multiple times a week because they want to avoid the ‘doggy’ smell, but veterinary dermatologists warn against such practices, as they are not good for a dog’s skin. If someone is really concerned about their dog’s smell they can use waterless shampoo and thoroughly brush their dog every day but keep the baths down to once or twice a week at most. Unless they have a skin condition for which a vet has prescribed medicated baths, most dogs don’t need to be bathed on a regular basis. Regular pet check-ups can help identify health problems before they become severe, making it easier to treat and manage them. Even dogs with thick, heavy coats generally only need baths every 6 to 8 weeks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 religiously가 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: religiously = (마치 규율처럼) 거르지 않고 규칙적으로, 열심히
det.analysis:
✅ ① 정해진 일과처럼 거르지 않고 규칙적으로: 'multiple times a week'와 어울리는 '꼬박꼬박 규칙적으로' ← 정답
❌ ② 종교적 신념에 따라 경건하게: religious의 축자적 의미로 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ 마지못해 이따금: '일주일에 여러 번'과 정면으로 모순
❌ ④ 수의사 지시에 맞추어: 오히려 수의사는 잦은 목욕을 경고함
det.tip: bathe religiously = 규칙처럼 꼬박꼬박 (자주) 목욕시키다
